name: contextscope-monorepo
description: ContextScope — open-source LLM context profiler & prompt cache debugger

scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --noEmit false && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.check:ui: node scripts/screenshots.mjs http://127.0.0.1:3377 shots && node scripts/click-check.mjs http://127.0.0.1:3377
